claim_text: Item sleeve came in with a huge rip along the seam at the wrist section.

_dev.why: plausible seam tear on cotton oxford cloth and clean account should keep risk low

claim_text: The visor arrived with a scratch on the lens that blocks vision.

_dev.why: lens scratch may look plausible, but new-account and refund-rate rules should raise risk

claim_text: The black moisturiser jar arrived cracked even though I ordered it new.

_dev.why: same claim image appears again in C004, so ImageReuse should hard-flag it

claim_text: The moisturiser came cracked on arrival and I need a refund.

_dev.why: identical image to C003 from a different risky account should trigger the reuse hard flag

claim_text: The mug has huge cracks at the bottom part and arrived in poor condition.

_dev.why: claim says bottom crack while image shows visible side cracks; risky account behaviour should push risk high

claim_text: Received my glass photo frame completely shattered, with large cracks and loose fragments inside the packaging.

_dev.why: shattered glass is physically plausible and shared-order logistics override should lower behavioural risk

claim_text: The USB hub connector broke before any use and the product arrived unusable.

_dev.why: detached connector is plausible transit damage and the shared order should be treated as logistics, not fraud

claim_text: The Acer monitor screen was already cracked when opened, with display damage straight out of the box.

_dev.why: cracked LCD damage is plausible and three claims share one order, so behavioural context should lower risk

claim_text: The audio interface arrived with the monitor knob snapped off and cracks spreading across the top panel.

_dev.why: aluminium dents or scuffs instead of fracturing radially, and the damage image was doctored from ssl2_intact.jpg
